assessments.reasoning: The three LibVNC/x11vnc captures at e2b726a8c0464051afda01648072af6835aaa5f7 cover bytes 0–48622 contiguously and report the claim’s file digest. The opening comment identifies this file as part of x11vnc and prints Runge’s complete grant.
The pinned License Index admission criterion covers an additional permission to a base license. The Index owns the classification. The project header establishes the actual grant and its boundaries.

challenge.method: Tested whether the permission survives an arbitrary change of OpenSSL license or automatically extends to a modified x11vnc file.
challenge.results: The same-license condition expressly qualifies modified OpenSSL versions. Runge permits optional extension to a modified version of this file and directs deletion of the statement if the modifier declines. The GPL remains applicable to the other code.

limitations: The header names x11vnc without a numbered release. The finding concerns the release language at this commit. Other files, releases, and particular OpenSSL license versions require separate evidence.
reasoning: LibVNC’s pinned src/8to24.c names Karl J. Runge as copyright holder and grantor. He gives permission to link “the code of its release of x11vnc” with the OpenSSL project’s library or modified versions using the same license, and to distribute the linked executables. This supports the Index’s active exception mapping for that representation.
